title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In August 2025, French Roofing replaced the shingle roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore the old roof off down to the decking, re-nailed loose wood, laid synthetic underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with attic ventilation, ridge cap and new flashing boots on the vent pipes.
scope: Tore off the old shingles and roof system down to the decking
Laid synthetic underlayment, with drip edge and starter shingles along the edges
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles, with step flashing where the roof meets the walls
Attic ventilation, plus ridge cap shingles on the ridges and hips
New flashing boots around the plumbing vent pipes
Cleaned up the job debris and ran a magnet over the site for nails
body: The old roof was gray shingles. Everything came off down to the wood, and the new roof went on in a warm brown CertainTeed Landmark. The photos follow it from the old lower roof, through the underlayment, to the new shingles around the vents and skylight.

faqs.question: Did the old roof come off on this Portland job?
faqs.answer: Yes. The old shingles and the rest of the old roof system came off down to the decking, and the crew re-nailed any loose wood before the new underlayment went down.

faqs.question: What shingles went on?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark shingles, over synthetic underlayment, with ridge cap on the ridges and hips and new flashing boots on the vent pipes.
